purpose: Adjudicate the verified Stage 5-12 pipeline into one coherent live market scenario context per canonical stock, including supporting evidence, conflicting evidence, confirmation conditions, invalidation conditions, and trigger integrity without generating or authorizing a trade.

inputs.stage6: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2 output
inputs.stage7: Stage 7 PSY29 Research-Conditioned Edge Activation output
inputs.stage8: Stage 8 PSY29 Portfolio Edge Ranking output
inputs.stage9: Stage 9 PSY29 Candidate Quality Confidence output
inputs.stage10: Stage 10 PSY29 Candidate Integrity Provenance output
inputs.stage11: Stage 11 PSY29 Live Execution Analysis output
inputs.stage12: Stage 12 PSY29 Live Execution Readiness & Scenario Gate output

13A_upstream_consistency_audit.purpose: Verify Stage 5-12 coverage, states, timestamps, provenance and cross-stage compatibility before adjudication.

13B_dominant_scenario_adjudication.purpose: Determine the dominant observable market scenario from verified live and research-conditioned evidence.

13C_scenario_evidence_stack.purpose: Expose supporting, neutral, conflicting, missing, stale and invalid evidence rather than hiding disagreement in an aggregate score.

13D_confirmation_condition.purpose: Describe the observable market condition required to confirm the adjudicated scenario.

13E_invalidation_condition.purpose: Describe the observable structural condition that invalidates the scenario.

13F_final_scenario_integrity_gate.purpose: Assign the final Stage 13 scenario state using fail-closed rules and complete provenance.

scenario_confirmed: All required Stage 5-12 dependencies are valid.
Stage 11 analysis is valid or sufficiently descriptive.
scenario_conditional: One or more confirmation/evidence components remain partial or moderate.
scenario_unconfirmed: Evidence is insufficient to establish a dominant scenario.
Stage 12 is blocked without stale/invalid data.
scenario_conflicted: Major live evidence sources materially disagree.
Conflicting evidence prevents a coherent dominant scenario.
data_invalid: Required data is malformed, missing, contradictory or unverifiable.
upstream_invalid: Stage 10 integrity is not INTEGRITY_PASS for a non-data-stale/non-data-invalid dependency.
Stage 11 or Stage 12 is blocked upstream.

provenance_contract.traceability_direction: Stage 13 -> Stage 12 -> Stage 11 -> Stage 10 -> Stage 9 -> Stage 8 -> Stage 7 -> Stage 6 -> Stage 5

fail_closed_rules: Missing, duplicate or unexpected symbols invalidate the run.
Missing Stage 5-12 dependencies cannot become valid.
Stale live data cannot become valid.
Invalid live data cannot become valid.
Missing provenance blocks valid scenario classification.
Material cross-stage contradiction cannot become SCENARIO_CONFIRMED.
Historical research evidence remains behavioural evidence only.
Stage 13 cannot select CE or PE.
Stage 13 cannot calculate monetary execution parameters.
immutability_rules: Stage 13 must not modify Stage 2-12 logic.
Stage 13 must not modify the canonical 29 universe.
Stage 13 must not modify historical research evidence.
Changes to this contract require an explicit Stage 13 version change.
Scenario confirmation is not trade authorization.
